description: Test counts the gate must see. suites, nodeTests and pythonTests describe the tree as it is: a commit that adds or removes tests changes them, and the floors in eng/test-suites.json, in the same commit. A Node test is a line that starts with test( in contracts/scripts/lib/*.test.mjs; a Python test is a def test_ function in eng/scripts/tests/test_*.py. measured records the last full gate measured twice in a row with equal counts; it changes only when the gate is measured again.
